hero.headline: Ramika Safaris and Tours
hero.lede: We design Tanzanian safaris that begin in the untamed Southern Highlands and parks, seamlessly expanding to Northern wildlife, Western wilderness, and Coastal getaways exactly when and where they fit your perfect journey.

image.alt: Wildflowers across a highland slope in southern Tanzania.

intro.headline: A southern start
body: Ramika Safaris and Tours Limited plans journeys across Tanzania. We begin where we know the land best – the southern highlands and nearby parks – and open northern, western, and coastal routes whenever they belong in the same journey.
Our vehicles are licensed and insured. Lodging is reserved to the standard you choose, and park entrance fees are paid by the guest.

testimonials.headline: Words from the road
testimonials.lede: Notes from travellers who planned southern highlands routes, park days, and soft landings with Ramika.

items.quote: The highland days felt unhurried. Our guide kept the road clear and the lodging to the standard we asked for.
items.name: Amelia Hart

items.quote: Mikumi was planned with care. We always knew what the day held, and the vehicle was ready for quiet watching.
items.name: Jonas Keller

items.quote: From Njombe the western road opened when we asked for it. Falls, shore, and lodging stayed practical.
items.name: Sofia Ndlovu

items.quote: Serengeti days were paced well. We never felt rushed between lodges, and the migration advice was honest.
items.name: Marco Bellini

items.quote: Zanzibar after the parks was the soft landing we wanted. Transfers were clear and the beach days stayed simple.
items.name: Priya Sharma

items.quote: A clean outline before we flew, and the same care on the ground. Ruaha felt wild without feeling uncertain.
items.name: Erik Johansson

items.quote: Family travel can be noisy. Ramika kept the days clear for the children and quiet enough for us.
items.name: Chloe Martin

items.quote: Chimpanzee days in the west asked for patience. The guide set that pace from the first morning.
items.name: Daniel Okoro

items.quote: Kitulo in flower season was the reason we came south first. The walks were gentle and the bandas were exactly as promised.
items.name: Hannah Brooks

items.quote: Mpanga Kipengere felt remote in the best way. Hiking with a local guide and then driving on to Kitulo made one clear highland story.
items.name: Lars Vermeulen

items.quote: Ngorongoro and Serengeti were added after our southern days. Ramika kept one itinerary, one vehicle standard, no confusion.
items.name: Aya Tanaka

items.quote: We asked for mid-range lodging and got it. Park fees were explained upfront, and WhatsApp replies came the same day.
items.name: Carlos Mendes

items.quote: Kalambo and the lake shore days balanced the wildlife mornings. Nothing felt padded for the sake of a brochure.
items.name: Nora Lindqvist

items.quote: Our balloon morning over the plains was timed around the game drives, not bolted on. That planning showed.
items.name: James O'Connell
